en:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.
Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.

The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.
{PLAYER} received TM04 from\nSABRINA.
TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.
Your BAG is full of other items.
SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.
Not good enough!
In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.
Does our unseen power scare you?
I never foresaw this!
PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!
POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!
I knew it!
I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…
You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?
I don't believe this!
SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!
I lost after all!
I knew that this was going to take\nplace.
SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!
Ow!\nDown and out!

There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!
Arrrgh!
That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!

Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!
Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
